comparison: 14/16 on r4-occam-ablation-v1 (14/14 on every neural G+D probe!), beating law4-energy-v3 on grid100_mlp16 (PASS 0.9924/0.0798 vs FAIL 0.9570/0.6775), vector_unequal_width (PASS 0.2582 vs FAIL 2.316), grid100 ctr (0.0794 vs 0.1249, first_pass 1000 vs 1500), and eliminating 100% of Critic 2D NS.
conclusion: law4-energy-v10 (Exact Polar-Frobenius-Matched 0-NS Critic sqrt(max(1,r/c))*sqrt(min(r,c))=sqrt(r) + 5-step 2D Polar G + 0 Conv2d NS + restored non-collapsing Tikhonov smoothing + 13775ca3c ema_func_gain + zero-.item() slow path) scored 14/16 PASS on r4-occam-ablation-v1, passing 14/14 neural generator+critic probes including grid100_mlp16 (prec=0.9924, ctr=0.0798), grid100 (prec=0.9882, ctr=0.0794, first_pass=1000!), model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (worst_cdf=0.0747, t1_q0_eig_max=1.1209), vector_unequal_width (hq=0.9993, cov=0.2582), vector_unequal_mass (0.9990), both >548x Nash tasks (0.9590/0.9900), ring16 (0.9895), img_bars4 (0.9688), five_word_joint_smoke, gaussian1d_stability, and zero_tanh_rail_escape. Only the two generator-free (G=nn.Identity) direct-cloud isolation probes missed by hair-thin margins (t3_iso_scale_mass_8x core_min_eigen_ratio=0.3375 vs 0.35; t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift pre_shift_hq=0.9219 PASS, hq=0.9062 vs 0.92), sharply delineating the Law 4.4 boundary.
